title: CRT compatibility conditions for non-prime modules
summary: Two congruence constraints x≡a (mod m) and x≡b (mod n) have solutions at the same time if and only if the difference between the two remainders is divisible by gcd(m,n).
applies: Integer modulo arithmetic; modulus greater than 1
detail: x≡1 (mod 4), x≡3 (mod 6) gives x≡9 (mod 12). The period of the solution is the least common multiple.
boundary: When they are not mutually prime, the period cannot always be written as m×n; if the conditions are incompatible, there will be no solution.
relevance: Distinguish contradictory observations from periodic repetitions when incorporating periodic cues.
